knowledgeBases.denseStageHelp: Vector (semantic) recall score from embedding similarity. Null means this chunk was not retrieved by the dense channel.
knowledgeBases.lexicalStageHelp: BM25 score from keyword matching. Higher values indicate stronger keyword overlap; no fixed upper bound.
knowledgeBases.fusionStageHelp: Weighted RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) score combining dense and lexical channels. Formula: Σ weight × 1/(rrf_k + rank).
knowledgeBases.rerankStageHelp: Cross-encoder relevance score (0-1) from the reranking model reading the full query and chunk text.
knowledgeBases.finalStageHelp: The score used for the final ranking. Shows which stage determined the final order (rerank, fusion, or single-channel recall).
